verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada runs an Online Filing Centre, so publishing its operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts is a fair question. The evidence only covers fees and processing times (1 day, 4-hour express, 10 days by mail). That is how long processing takes, not when the online flow is available or how long a session lasts. No operating-hours window, daily submission limit, or session-timeout disclosure appears anywhere in the pack.
